summary: Seven verifiers reported 33 findings on the stage-2c candidate. I re-ran every repro myself, alone, on the quiet machine (my ports 5388 / 5398; scripts that default to another verifier's port were given MDR_PORT=5388, nothing else changed). All 33 reproduced. FID-3's fast variant failed 2 of 3 runs, its slow variant 3 of 3. None was flaky beyond that and none failed to reproduce. They fall into 29 groups H1-H29 (one group = one fix): 6 high, 10 medium, 13 low.
**By the release gate this candidate must not ship.**
- 4 high groups are new in 0.2.0 or regressions: H1 (U10 bypass), H2 (file dropped onto the editor, a regression), H3 (Backspace in an emptied paragraph) and H4 (paste written twice).
- 3 groups are regressions against 0.1.1 at medium or above: H2, H7 (GBK read as damaged UTF-8) and H8 (selection lost after a session).
- H5 and H6 are high but pre-existing. H5 is the G28 class, a crash draft overwritten. H6 is page script blanking the window.
- 8 medium groups are new-feature defects or a spec gap (H9-H16) and need a fix or an explicit acceptance.
The worst problems, in plain terms:
- A downloaded document can still steer in-preview editing (H1). One typed letter turns hidden raw HTML into a visible formula on disk, and a checkbox click can tick another task.

- Dragging a .md file from Finder onto the editor pane splices that file's text into the open document (H2). A clean document is then asked 放弃更改, and 取消 keeps the mixed text. 0.1.1 simply opened the file.
- One Backspace after emptying a paragraph glues the next block's raw Markdown onto the paragraph above (H3). A heading becomes '## …' text and a fence breaks.
- Pasting paragraphs that end in a whitespace-only line at a paragraph start writes the pasted text twice (H4).
- GBK data files whose Chinese happens to look like UTF-8 byte pairs (小时, 千元) now open as garbage with a 'damaged UTF-8' dialog (H7). 0.1.1 read them correctly.
- After clicking into a paragraph, a drag-selection across paragraphs copies from the paragraph start (H8, regression).

What the stage-2c step itself changed held up. U13 held 24 + 15 Chromium cases and U14 held 9 + 3 cases. The fixer's claim about unkeepReusedId / held was checked by three verifiers. The only defect there is a one- or two-frame flash when an older structure arrives after the deletion (H20, low).

held.verify-fidelity: No false U12 refusal of an ordinary block: direct walks of medium.md (6002 blocks), large.md (30002), small.md, README and docs found 17 refusals, all raw HTML (K4); 500 real clicks found 0. No false pass in 292 written sessions over adversarial documents (0 rendering differences, 0 bytes outside the block). Click + Esc writes nothing (530 blocks). The list cache matches uncached serialization with per-call markers (6 seeds x 150 sequences). Typed Markdown characters stay literal. U13 meets the serializer (15 Chromium cases). U14 keeps leading lines.
held.verify-session: U13: 24 cases plus undo/redo byte for byte. U14 holds for every first-block kind. unkeepReusedId / held: 10 per-frame sampled cases, only the SES-6 flash. The P1 class: 8 history cases, no lost keys. U7 pointer gestures: 30 cases, only SES-4 fails. Paste: about 45 cases, only SES-5, SES-8 and SES-9 fail. An oracle fuzz (about 33 seeds, small / human speed / large.md) found SES-8 and SES-9. IME, drag and drop and the editing toggle around sessions also held.
held.verify-app: Saving with pending session text or an emptied block, on every web save path, writes exactly the screen. Replacing the document during a session never leaks its text. Draft offers against a live session work. Block identity with duplicates and leading lines: 23/24 (the one mismatch was a wrong expectation). The ghost survives far scrolling. UI operations right after typing work (11/11). Desktop dev shell 14/14 and staging 5/5. With editing off the preview behaves like 0.1.1 (18 probes). large.md sessions at top, middle and end are exact. The dirty flag is right.
held.verify-flows: Typing during a slow save keeps a newer draft. Session text counts as dirty for every replacing request and for quit. The window closes only when confirmed. OS document bursts give one question. Drafts around save / 不保存 work. argv failures are named. An IME composition at close is saved. ⌘Q with the 打开… panel up asks. A folder or FIFO open-file never loses the document. No crash dialogs.
held.verify-shell: No document content navigates the window, opens a window or downloads (372 activations + 11 static carriers). 37 page-script vectors other than about:blank / about:srcdoc are cancelled. The open queue is right after every cancelled navigation (196/196 + 6/6). The dev-URL rule holds (10/10). Closing or quitting around full-screen transitions caused 0 crashes in 33 cases. G38 holds for the whole class. Drops never navigate. The lifecycle scripts reproduce the integrator's numbers. A line-by-line read of the main.mjs diff found no stuck flag.
held.verify-decoder: Over 95 830 inputs in Node and in the Electron main process, no refusal other than the binary rule, no label that fails to round-trip and no U+FFFD in a non-UTF-8 reading. With the switch off the results equal the fixture (0 differences). Unmodified and +1 saves keep every byte. meta.table survives conflict, retry and reload. The K11 dialog appears exactly for lenient UTF-8. Large-file sampling agrees with the whole-file decision. The thresholds sit where documented.
held.verify-review: The unkeepReusedId / held claim holds: every caller was read, and 4 slow-worker cases passed 8/8. No listener or element leaks over 120 sessions and 40 loads. The sanitizer config and CSP are unchanged apart from the new hook. The gate's main-thread render cannot run script. The regexes are linear except REV-3. Nothing on the session path inserts HTML from document text. A directly forged data-l is flagged.

decoderVerdict: Yes, there is a reproduced decoder regression of medium or above against 0.1.1: DEC-1 (group H7, medium, regression-vs-shipped). It reproduced in the unit test (4/4) and end to end in the staging shell on open-file, the 打开… panel and a drop: dialog 「…不是完全有效的 UTF-8 文本」, and a save rewrites 378 bytes. The baseline shell reads the same file as GBK and saves exact+x. By S4 (f), override 3 (lenient UTF-8) must not replace a clean CJK reading that scores as real text; otherwise the release ships with DECODER_OVERRIDES off. Switching the overrides off removes DEC-1 (it is override 3). It does not remove DEC-2 (H23, a low regression: 22 bytes respelled instead of 2 in a constructed NEC-style Shift_JIS file), because the save-table rule is not behind the switch. DEC-3 (H27) is pre-existing and DEC-4 (H28) is test methodology. Its effect also applies to the frozen 0.1.0 fixture, which decodes 88 of 1072 inputs differently in Node and in Electron, so decoder differentials must run in Electron.
scriptNotes: bench/verify/v3-ses-paste.mjs limit-prose-sel-replaced fails, but only because its option pre:'sel500' is not implemented: no selection is made, so 59 004 + 1 100 characters is rightly refused. This is a script artifact, not a product failure.

bench/verify/fix2-int-p5.mjs on a production build needs a server that adds ?perf=1: its warmUp opens a URL without it and times out after 90 s on vite preview. I used a 25-line static server in my scratch directory, as the integrator did.

bench/verify/v3-app-g.mjs and v3-app-regress.mjs printed nothing when started from a nohup'd sh batch with perl alarm and a pipe, and one v3-app-regress process outlived the batch. Run directly, they work. I ran them directly.
v3-app-regress.mjs takes only one case filter (argv[2]).
npx playwright test writes test-results/ into the tree.
